newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Jan commodity futures volume down 4.2% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Jan commodity futures volume down 4.2% yr/yr.

text.p: Futures trading volume on Japan's 10 commodity exchanges totalled 6,729,623 lots in January, down 4.2 percent from a year ago but up 37.7 percent from December, the Japan Federation of Commodity Exchanges said on Monday.
The Tokyo Grain Exchange's yen-based corn futures contract posted the largest turnover in January at 1,752,422 lots.
"Volatile grain futures markets attracted speculative interest from local investors," an association official said.
